_comment: Hand corrections applied on top of the archived snapshot, each with its source. The MetaTFT file is a
pre-launch PBE build; `lol.py tft check` compares it with the patch notes and drafts these.
`stats` replace a base stat. `curve` rows list per-star values from 1★: several values replace the
first stars and leave the higher ones as they were; a single value makes the row that constant.
`traits` overrides name a trait's curve rows by breakpoint column ("1" is the first breakpoint, "0" the inactive value); other columns keep the snapshot's value.

TFT18_Soraka._source: patch 18.1 notes: Soraka Initial Star Damage 190/285 ⇒ 225/335

TFT18_Draven._source: patch 18.1 notes: Draven Mana 0/120 ⇒ 0/110; Base AS 0.8 ⇒ 0.85

TFT18_ElderDragon._source: patch 18.1 notes: Elder Dragon Base AD ⇒ 125

TFT18_Lux_Base._source: patch 18.1 notes: Lux Ability Damage 330/520 ⇒ 355/550; Lux Lunar Damage Amp 10% ⇒ 8%

TFT18_Cassiopeia._source: patch 18.1 notes: Cassiopeia Ability Damage 440/660/1050 ⇒ 400/600/950 (the snapshot had 425/640/1020, an earlier PBE build)

TFT18_Ahri._source: patch 18.1 notes: Ahri Ability Damage 450/675 ⇒ 425/640 (the snapshot had 485/735)

TFT18_Fiddlesticks._source: Community Dragon latest/cdragon/tft/en_us.json (TFTSet18) 2026-09-04, corroborated by wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/TFT:Fiddlesticks; the PBE MetaTFT file lacks the value

TFT18_Ivern._source: Community Dragon latest/cdragon/tft/en_us.json (TFTSet18) 2026-09-04, corroborated by wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/TFT:Ivern; the PBE MetaTFT file lacks the value

TFT18_KogMaw._source: Community Dragon latest/cdragon/tft/en_us.json (TFTSet18, DA_KogMaw18_AD damage 40) 2026-09-04; the PBE MetaTFT file has no attack damage for him

DA_Riftbeast18._source: patch 18.1 notes: Riftbeast (7) Stats 6% AD/AP/AS ⇒ 5% AD/AP/AS (the (10) column carried the same value, so both are set)
